blurb.es: Argent Flow como único carry, con tres soportes. Todo el daño se concentra en su Ultimate: durante la pelea se acumula Sunderization y la Crush de la Ultimate lo detona. El objetivo del autor es llegar a 12 de Sunderization con Electrification de nivel 4. Incluye la versión más simple, sin esperar 3 barras de SP, y aportes de 终末协约攻略组 y Raaay丶.
blurb.en: Argent Flow as the only carry, with three supports. All the damage is concentrated in his Ultimate: Sunderization builds up during the fight and the Ultimate's Crush detonates it. The author's goal is reaching 12 Sunderization with level 4 Electrification. Includes the simpler version, with no waiting for 3 SP bars, and contributions from 终末协约攻略组 and Raaay丶.

whatItDoes.es: La Battle Skill de Argent Flow aplica Lift, y eso da Vulnerability, que hace salir su Combo. El Combo pone Electric Infliction y cambia su Battle Skill por Bolt Rush. Bolt Rush fuerza una Electrification y sube un nivel por cada Electric Infliction que consume. Cada Electrification de Argent Flow añade tantas acumulaciones de Sunderization como su nivel, hasta 12. Su Ultimate aplica Crush, que detona todas las acumulaciones de golpe. Arcane en forma WILL duplica las Inflictions, Gilberta aporta Arts Susceptibility con su Ultimate y Liino da ATK y Electric Amp.
whatItDoes.en: Argent Flow's Battle Skill applies Lift, which gives Vulnerability and brings out his Combo. The Combo puts Electric Infliction and changes his Battle Skill to Bolt Rush. Bolt Rush forces an Electrification and goes up one level per Electric Infliction it consumes. Each of Argent Flow's Electrifications adds as many Sunderization stacks as its level, up to 12. His Ultimate applies Crush, which detonates all the stacks at once. WILL-form Arcane duplicates Inflictions, Gilberta brings Arts Susceptibility with her Ultimate and Liino gives ATK and Electric Amp.

overview.es: El autor parte del talento de Argent Flow: Sunderization, 330% de ATK por acumulación hasta 12, con bonus por Arts Intensity, y lo detona una Crush, la de su Ultimate. De ahí sale toda la lógica: acumular Sunderization y soltarlo todo en la Ultimate. Arcane da más acumulaciones; Gilberta, la Arts Susceptibility; Liino, ATK y Electric Amp. La vuelta normal (1EE1EE en su notación: 1 es la Battle Skill de Argent Flow y E, los Combos) cuesta 2 barras de SP, dispara cuatro Combos y suma 3 de Sunderization. Tras dos vueltas hay 6. La tercera se cambia por una de burst pensada para terminar con 12 de Sunderization y Electrification de nivel 4: 2 con el Bolt Rush y 4 con la Electrification final, que sale de cuatro Nature Infliction. Quien no quiera esperar 3 barras de SP puede hacer una tercera vuelta normal y soltar las Ultimates: quedan 11 de Sunderization con nivel 2. 终末协约攻略组 y Raaay丶 sacan videos del mismo cuarteto; sus aportes van como variantes y alternativas.
overview.en: The author starts from Argent Flow's talent: Sunderization, 330% ATK per stack up to 12, with a bonus from Arts Intensity, detonated by a Crush, the one on his Ultimate. All the logic comes from that: build Sunderization and release it all on the Ultimate. Arcane gives more stacks; Gilberta, the Arts Susceptibility; Liino, ATK and Electric Amp. The normal loop (1EE1EE in the author's notation: 1 is Argent Flow's Battle Skill and E, the Combos) costs 2 SP bars, fires four Combos and adds 3 Sunderization. After two loops there are 6. The third is swapped for a burst loop designed to end with 12 Sunderization and level 4 Electrification: 2 from Bolt Rush and 4 from the final Electrification, which comes from four Nature Inflictions. Anyone who does not want to wait for 3 SP bars can do a third normal loop and release the Ultimates: that leaves 11 Sunderization at level 2. 终末协约攻略组 and Raaay丶 have videos of the same quartet; their contributions go in as variants and alternatives.

cons.en: Damage depends almost entirely on one window: per 终末协约攻略组, Argent Flow's Ultimate. 终末协约攻略组's video recommends it for long-cycle bosses and a burst in Stagger.

cons.es: La vuelta de burst obliga a contener el Combo de Arcane, que sale pero no debe pulsarse.
cons.en: The burst loop means holding back Arcane's Combo, which comes out but must not be pressed.

title.es: Bolt Rush convierte Inflictions en Sunderization
title.en: Bolt Rush turns Inflictions into Sunderization

body.es: Darkness Cowed aplica Lift y deja Vulnerability, y eso hace salir el Combo de Argent Flow, que pone 1 Electric Infliction. En la demo también sale el de Arcane, que en forma WILL añade otra. Bolt Rush fuerza una Electrification de nivel 1 y le suma un nivel por cada Electric Infliction consumida: con dos queda en nivel 3. Argent Flow aplica tantas acumulaciones de Sunderization como ese nivel, hasta 12. Como la Electrification se sustituye y la Sunderization se acumula, la vuelta siguiente deja otra vez nivel 3, pero ya 6 acumulaciones.
body.en: Darkness Cowed applies Lift and leaves Vulnerability, which brings out Argent Flow's Combo, which puts 1 Electric Infliction. In the demo Arcane's also comes out, and in WILL form it adds another. Bolt Rush forces a level 1 Electrification and adds one level per Electric Infliction consumed: with two it ends at level 3. Argent Flow applies as many Sunderization stacks as that level, up to 12. Since Electrification overwrites and Sunderization stacks, the next loop leaves level 3 again, but already 6 stacks.

title.es: La cuenta de los 12 con nivel 4

body.es: Tras dos vueltas hay 6. Si la Electrification final es de nivel 4, aporta 4 más, así que faltan 2: por eso el Bolt Rush del burst consume solo 1 Electric Infliction y deja nivel 2 con 2 acumulaciones. El nivel 4 sale de cuatro Nature Infliction: la Battle Skill de Arcane, su Combo, la Ultimate de Gilberta y la de Arcane. Según el autor, la Ultimate de Argent Flow pone primero la Electric Infliction y calcula después el daño, de modo que esa Infliction convierte las cuatro Nature en Electrification de nivel 4 antes de la detonación.
body.en: After two loops there are 6. If the final Electrification is level 4, it adds 4 more, so 2 are missing: that is why the burst's Bolt Rush consumes only 1 Electric Infliction and leaves level 2 with 2 stacks. Level 4 comes from four Nature Inflictions: Arcane's Battle Skill, her Combo, Gilberta's Ultimate and Arcane's. Per the author, Argent Flow's Ultimate puts the Electric Infliction first and calculates damage afterwards, so that Infliction turns the four Nature into level 4 Electrification before the detonation.

title.es: Qué aporta cada soporte a la ventana
title.en: What each support adds to the window

body.es: La Ultimate de Gilberta aplica Arts Susceptibility, que sube con cada acumulación de Vulnerability del objetivo. La Ultimate de Liino da Electric Amp, Nature Amp y ATK Boost al equipo. Arcane aporta Nature Infliction y, además, Nature Susceptibility y Cryo Susceptibility con su Combo. El orden 4-3-2-1 de las Ultimates hace, según Raaay丶, que todo el daño caiga con la Arts Susceptibility de Gilberta puesta.
body.en: Gilberta's Ultimate applies Arts Susceptibility, which grows with each Vulnerability stack on the target. Liino's Ultimate gives the team Electric Amp, Nature Amp and ATK Boost. Arcane brings Nature Infliction and, with her Combo, Nature Susceptibility and Cryo Susceptibility. The 4-3-2-1 Ultimate order means, per Raaay丶, that all the damage lands with Gilberta's Arts Susceptibility on.

do.en: Liino's Battle Skill: she enters Vocalist Stance, which gives ATK Boost and enables her Combo.

tip.en: In the video, the formation is Argent Flow, Arcane, Gilberta and Liino, in that order: that is what the 1 / 2 / 4-3-2-1 notation uses.

action.en: Darkness Cowed → Argent Flow's Combo → Arcane's Combo → Bolt Rush → Liino's and Gilberta's Combos. Adds 3 Sunderization per loop.

do.en: Darkness Cowed when Argent Flow's Combo is ready: it applies Lift and leaves Vulnerability.

do.en: Argent Flow's Combo: 1 Electric Infliction, and his Battle Skill changes to Bolt Rush.

do.en: Bolt Rush when Gilberta's Combo is about to return: it has a windup. Level 3 Electrification and 3 Sunderization, plus 1 Vulnerability for consuming the Infliction.

do.en: The Electrification brings out Liino's and Gilberta's Combos: press them.

tip.en: While waiting for cooldowns, basics. Each loop costs 2 SP bars.

do.en: Darkness Cowed and Argent Flow's Combo. Arcane's comes out, but do not press it: it is saved for the Nature.

do.en: Bolt Rush: it consumes only 1 Electric Infliction and leaves level 2, adding 2 Sunderization (8 total). The Combos come out again: do not press them yet either, because Arcane's would put another Electric Infliction and there is no other Bolt Rush left to consume it.

do.en: Arcane's Battle Skill: 1st Nature Infliction. There is 1 SP bar left for it because you started with nearly 3.

do.en: Liino's Ultimate.

do.es: Ultimate de Gilberta: 3.ª Nature y Arts Susceptibility. Si vas muy rápido, deja un instante antes de la siguiente: puede que su Nature aún no se haya aplicado.
do.en: Gilberta's Ultimate: 3rd Nature and Arts Susceptibility. If you go very fast, leave a moment before the next: her Nature may not have applied yet.

do.es: Ultimate de Arcane: 4.ª Nature, copiando el elemento.
do.en: Arcane's Ultimate: 4th Nature, copying the element.

do.es: Ultimate de Argent Flow: su Electric Infliction convierte las cuatro Nature en Electrification de nivel 4 (+4 = 12 de Sunderization) y la Crush lo detona todo.
do.en: Argent Flow's Ultimate: his Electric Infliction turns the four Nature into level 4 Electrification (+4 = 12 Sunderization) and the Crush detonates it all.

tip.es: El autor pide respetar el orden 4-3-2-1 de las Ultimates y ordenar los Combos en la formación como en su diagrama. Lo atribuye a cómo se encadenan los Combos: así el de Arcane pone Nature y la Ultimate de Gilberta no interrumpe su propio Combo.
tip.en: The author asks to keep the 4-3-2-1 Ultimate order and to arrange Combos in the formation as in the diagram. It comes down to how Combos chain: that way Arcane's puts Nature and Gilberta's Ultimate does not interrupt her own Combo.

description.es: De 股神小炉, para quien no quiera esperar 3 barras de SP. Tras tres vueltas normales hay 9 de Sunderization; la Electrification final sale de nivel 2, con la Nature de Gilberta y la de Arcane, y quedan 11. Según el autor, el daño alcanza y se gasta una Battle Skill menos.
description.en: From 股神小炉, for anyone who does not want to wait for 3 SP bars. After three normal loops there are 9 Sunderization; the final Electrification comes out at level 2, with Gilberta's and Arcane's Nature, leaving 11. Per the author, the damage is enough and one fewer Battle Skill is spent.

phase.en: Three normal loops and the Ultimates

do.en: If you have very fast hands, leave a moment between Gilberta's Ultimate and Arcane's: her Nature may not apply before Arcane's finishes.

name.es: 终末协约攻略组: sin memorizar el eje
name.en: 终末协约攻略组: no axis to memorize

description.es: Arcane es el personaje controlado y solo hace básicos durante toda la pelea. Liino lanza su Battle Skill al abrir y después se repite: Battle Skill de Argent Flow, Bolt Rush, y cada Combo de los demás en cuanto esté listo. El autor lo plantea para esperar el Stagger del jefe y soltar el burst entonces.
description.en: Arcane is the controlled operator and only does basics for the whole fight. Liino casts her Battle Skill to open and then it repeats: Argent Flow's Battle Skill, Bolt Rush, and everyone else's Combo as soon as it is ready. The author proposes it for waiting for the boss's Stagger and releasing the burst then.

action.es: Battle Skill de Liino → (Battle Skill y Combo de Argent Flow → Bolt Rush → los Combos que estén listos) en bucle.
action.en: Liino's Battle Skill → (Argent Flow's Battle Skill and Combo → Bolt Rush → whichever Combos are ready) on loop.

do.es: Básicos con Arcane durante toda la pelea, también mientras esperas los cooldowns de Combo.
do.en: Basics with Arcane for the whole fight, also while waiting for Combo cooldowns.

do.es: Battle Skill y Combo de Argent Flow, Combo de Arcane y Bolt Rush.
do.en: Argent Flow's Battle Skill and Combo, Arcane's Combo and Bolt Rush.

do.es: Combos de Gilberta y Liino en cuanto salgan. Solo recuerda mantener la Battle Skill de Liino.
do.en: Gilberta's and Liino's Combos as soon as they come out. Just remember to keep Liino's Battle Skill up.

action.es: Battle Skill y Combo de Argent Flow → Bolt Rush → Ultimate de Gilberta → Combo de Arcane → Combos de Gilberta y Liino → Ultimates de Arcane, Liino y Argent Flow.
action.en: Argent Flow's Battle Skill and Combo → Bolt Rush → Gilberta's Ultimate → Arcane's Combo → Gilberta's and Liino's Combos → Arcane's, Liino's and Argent Flow's Ultimates.

do.es: La Ultimate de Liino no necesita esperar: mantén pulsada de una vez la de Argent Flow. Así la Electrification de Liino queda sustituida por la de nivel 3 de Argent Flow. Con esta versión el autor llega a nivel 3 y 10 de Sunderization.
do.en: Liino's Ultimate does not need to wait: hold Argent Flow's right away. That way Liino's Electrification gets overwritten by Argent Flow's level 3 one. With this version the author reaches level 3 and 10 Sunderization.

do.es: Si el jefe sigue vivo tras el burst, el autor termina la Ultimate de Liino antes de tiempo, porque el daño de Argent Flow se concentra en su Ultimate. Según el kit, al terminarla antes no sale el golpe final de la postura.
do.en: If the boss is still alive after the burst, the author ends Liino's Ultimate early, since Argent Flow's damage is concentrated in his Ultimate. Per the kit, ending it early skips the stance's final hit.

description.es: Se juega igual por parte de Argent Flow, pero separa los Combos para colocar una Corrosion: según el autor, se pagan 2 de Sunderization por una Corrosion de nivel 1, el Combo de Liino vuelve rápido y separar los Combos reduce la presión de Ultimate Gain. Raaay丶 advierte que en la versión simple sin Corrosion las diferencias de equipo apenas importan.
description.en: Argent Flow plays the same, but the Combos are split to place a Corrosion: per the author, 2 Sunderization pay for a level 1 Corrosion, Liino's Combo returns quickly, and splitting Combos reduces Ultimate Gain pressure. Raaay丶 notes that in the simple version without Corrosion, gear differences barely matter.

action.es: Battle Skill y Combo de Argent Flow → Bolt Rush → Combos de Arcane, Gilberta y Liino → Battle Skill de Arcane → Combo de Liino.
action.en: Argent Flow's Battle Skill and Combo → Bolt Rush → Arcane's, Gilberta's and Liino's Combos → Arcane's Battle Skill → Liino's Combo.

do.es: No pulses el Combo de Arcane hasta después de Bolt Rush.
do.en: Do not press Arcane's Combo until after Bolt Rush.

do.es: Battle Skill de Arcane tras Bolt Rush: convierte la Electric Infliction en Corrosion y vuelve a hacer salir el Combo de Liino.
do.en: Arcane's Battle Skill after Bolt Rush: it turns the Electric Infliction into Corrosion and brings out Liino's Combo again.

name.es: 终末协约攻略组: Combo de Argent Flow con el de Gilberta
name.en: 终末协约攻略组: Argent Flow's Combo via Gilberta's

description.es: El autor lo presenta como conocimiento avanzado. El Combo de Argent Flow sale al aplicarse Vulnerability, y el de Gilberta también la aplica mediante Lift. Si retrasas el segundo Combo de Gilberta hasta que el de Argent Flow esté por volver, te ahorras una Battle Skill de Argent Flow y gastas ese SP en otra de Arcane. Según el autor, su burst pasa de nivel 3 y 10 de Sunderization a nivel 4 y 11. Mientras el jefe no se mueva tanto como para fallar el Combo, el autor dice que compensa.
description.en: The author presents it as advanced knowledge. Argent Flow's Combo fires when Vulnerability is applied, and Gilberta's also applies it through Lift. If you delay Gilberta's second Combo until Argent Flow's is about to return, you save one Argent Flow Battle Skill and spend that SP on another for Arcane. Per the author, the burst goes from level 3 and 10 Sunderization to level 4 and 11. As long as the boss does not move enough to whiff the Combo, the author says it pays off.

action.es: Bolt Rush → Combo de Arcane → Combo de Liino → Battle Skill de Arcane → Combo de Liino → Combo de Gilberta.
action.en: Bolt Rush → Arcane's Combo → Liino's Combo → Arcane's Battle Skill → Liino's Combo → Gilberta's Combo.

do.es: Pon a Liino antes que Gilberta en la formación, para poder no pulsar el Combo de Gilberta.
do.en: Put Liino ahead of Gilberta in the formation, so you can leave Gilberta's Combo unpressed.

do.es: No pulses el primer Combo de Gilberta; espera a que termine. El segundo también se retiene hasta que el Combo de Argent Flow esté por volver.
do.en: Do not press Gilberta's first Combo; wait for it to end. Hold the second too, until Argent Flow's Combo is about to return.

name.es: Raaay丶: dos vueltas de carga y un burst
name.en: Raaay丶: two charge loops and a burst

description.es: La misma estructura base, con tres matices: si la segunda vuelta va rápido y se queda sin Combo de Gilberta (1EE y 1E), no pasa nada, porque hay Ultimate Gain suficiente aunque Gilberta no lance ninguno. Antes del burst hay que esperar a casi 3 barras de SP, y Raaay丶 lo resume en que tres Battle Skills terminan la pelea. Al acabar el burst, dos Final Strikes activan el segundo Ultimate de Arcane.
description.en: The same base structure, with three nuances: if the second loop goes fast and has no Gilberta Combo (1EE and 1E), it does not matter, because there is enough Ultimate Gain even if Gilberta casts none. Before the burst you wait for nearly 3 SP bars, and Raaay丶 sums it up as three Battle Skills ending the fight. When the burst ends, two Final Strikes enable Arcane's second Ultimate.

action.es: Tres puntos del autor, sobre su diagrama.
action.en: The author's three points, over the diagram.

do.es: Battle Skill de Liino al inicio de cada ciclo.
do.en: Liino's Battle Skill at the start of each cycle.

do.es: Tras el burst, dos Final Strikes: la Ultimate de Arcane cambia a Gloompurge Arcana y se puede lanzar.
do.en: After the burst, two Final Strikes: Arcane's Ultimate changes to Gloompurge Arcana and can be cast.

do.es: En el burst, no pulses el Combo de Arcane tras el de Argent Flow. Es el paso difícil.
do.en: In the burst, do not press Arcane's Combo after Argent Flow's. It is the hard step.

order.es: Combo (especialización 3) > Ultimate (especialización 3) > Battle Skill (especialización 3) > Ataque básico (especialización 3)
order.en: Combo (specialization 3) > Ultimate (specialization 3) > Battle Skill (specialization 3) > Basic attack (specialization 3)

note.es: Discrepan: 终末协约攻略组 da Battle Skill > Ultimate = Combo > Ataque básico, y Raaay丶 da Ultimate > Battle Skill > Combo (rango 9) > Ataque básico (rango 9). Refinado según 股神小炉: Ultimate Gain en el gear; después los demás atributos, el principal y el secundario. En su arma, primero el atributo 1 y 2, que de todos modos se llenan.
note.en: They disagree: 终末协约攻略组 gives Battle Skill > Ultimate = Combo > Basic attack, and Raaay丶 gives Ultimate > Battle Skill > Combo (rank 9) > Basic attack (rank 9). Artificing per 股神小炉: Ultimate Gain on gear; then the other attributes, the main and the secondary. On his weapon, attributes 1 and 2 first, which get maxed anyway.

note.es: Es lo único que fija 股神小炉. 终末协约攻略组: Combo (especialización 3) > Ultimate > Battle Skill = Ataque básico. Arma: primero el atributo 2 (Ultimate Gain), luego el 3; el 1 no hace falta en este equipo.

With Antal's Focus on, Antal's Combo applies another stack of the same Infliction. Bolt Rush forces an Electrification that goes up a level per Electric Infliction consumed, and adds as many Sunderization stacks as that level. The Crush on Argent Flow's Ultimate detonates them all.

In exchange, although his Ultimate is strong, far less Sunderization stacks and the Corrosion is lost, which the author values highly. He can also replace Liino in special cases, with no further detail. The video has no demo of this team of its own: the loop comes from applying that swap to the Arcane version, and here it stays within what the author says. The Arcane version, with its bursts and Sunderization math, is in 股神小炉's comp.

overview.es: El autor enseña primero un eje normal bastante simple, de tres vueltas: carga 1, carga 2 y burst, siempre en ese orden. Basta con memorizar una vuelta y el orden de las cuatro Ultimates. En la carga 1, los Combos de Argent Flow y Antal ponen dos Electric Infliction, Bolt Rush las convierte en Electrification de nivel 3, y los Combos de Rossi y Camille cierran. La carga 2 es la misma sin la Battle Skill de Antal. El burst abre con las Ultimates de Rossi, Antal y Camille, intercala la Hunter Pursuit de Camille y cierra con la Ultimate de Argent Flow. La segunda página es el eje avanzado: el Combo de Argent Flow de la carga 2 se activa con la segunda fase del Combo de Rossi de la vuelta anterior, la Battle Skill de Rossi pasa a después de Bolt Rush para que su Razor Clawmark llegue a su Ultimate, y el burst se rehace para que la Ultimate de Argent Flow consuma 3 Heat Infliction en lugar de 2. La tabla final da la build y el umbral de cada uno.
overview.en: The author first teaches a fairly simple normal axis of three loops: charge 1, charge 2 and burst, always in that order. You only need to memorize one loop and the order of the four Ultimates. In charge 1, Argent Flow's and Antal's Combos put two Electric Infliction, Bolt Rush converts them into a level 3 Electrification, and Rossi's and Camille's Combos close. Charge 2 is the same without Antal's Battle Skill. The burst opens with Rossi's, Antal's and Camille's Ultimates, fits in Camille's Hunter Pursuit and closes with Argent Flow's Ultimate. The second page is the advanced axis: Argent Flow's Combo in charge 2 is triggered by the second sequence of Rossi's Combo from the previous loop, Rossi's Battle Skill moves to after Bolt Rush so her Razor Clawmark reaches her Ultimate, and the burst is reworked so Argent Flow's Ultimate consumes 3 Heat Infliction instead of 2. The final table gives each member's build and threshold.

overview.es: El autor presenta un equipo de doble carry con Argent Flow y Perlica, y destaca que el eje es simple y deja bastante margen de error. Son tres vueltas. En la primera de carga, una Final Strike permite pulsar los cuatro Combos; Perlica y Argent Flow generan Electrification sin parar, y la Battle Skill de Arclight la consume para activar varias veces su Combo, que recupera SP. La segunda de carga es igual, con una Battle Skill de Perlica más. Según el autor, esas Battle Skills de Perlica no tienen un momento estricto. El burst son las cuatro Ultimates seguidas. La tabla final da la build y el umbral de Ultimate Gain de cada uno, y el último aviso es apurar lo que sigue a la segunda Battle Skill de Arclight para que las Ultimates de Argent Flow y Perlica aprovechen el buff de su talento.
overview.en: The author presents a dual-carry team with Argent Flow and Perlica, and stresses that the axis is simple and leaves plenty of room for error. There are three loops. In the first charge loop, one Final Strike lets you press all four Combos; Perlica and Argent Flow keep generating Electrification, and Arclight's Battle Skill consumes it to trigger her Combo several times, which recovers SP. The second charge loop is the same, with one more Perlica Battle Skill. Per the author, those Perlica Battle Skills have no strict timing. The burst is all four Ultimates in a row. The final table gives each member's build and Ultimate Gain threshold, and the last tip is to hurry everything after Arclight's second Battle Skill so Argent Flow's and Perlica's Ultimates benefit from her talent's buff.

title.es: Una Final Strike enciende la cadena
title.en: One Final Strike lights the chain

body.es: El Combo de Perlica sale con cualquier Final Strike del personaje controlado y fuerza Electrification. Esa Electrification abre el Combo de Arclight (sale cuando el enemigo sufre Electrification o se la consumen) y el de Gilberta (sale con una Arts Reaction). El Combo de Gilberta fuerza Lift, que deja Vulnerability, y eso abre el de Argent Flow. Por eso el autor los pulsa los cuatro tras una sola Final Strike.
body.en: Perlica's Combo fires on any Final Strike by the controlled operator and forces Electrification. That Electrification opens Arclight's Combo (it fires when the enemy suffers Electrification or has it consumed) and Gilberta's (it fires on an Arts Reaction). Gilberta's Combo forces Lift, which leaves Vulnerability, and that opens Argent Flow's. That is why the author presses all four after a single Final Strike.

body.es: La Battle Skill de Arclight consume la Electrification activa para lanzar un ataque adicional de Electric DMG que recupera SP, y esa consumición vuelve a abrir su Combo, que también recupera SP. Bolt Rush genera otra Electrification y abre su Combo una vez más. Con un cooldown de 3 s, su Combo sale varias veces por vuelta: de ahí sale el SP que sostiene el eje.
body.en: Arclight's Battle Skill consumes active Electrification to unleash an additional Electric DMG attack that recovers SP, and that consumption reopens her Combo, which also recovers SP. Bolt Rush generates another Electrification and opens her Combo once more. With a 3 s cooldown, her Combo comes out several times per loop: that is where the SP sustaining the axis comes from.

body.es: El Combo de Argent Flow pone Electric Infliction y cambia su Battle Skill a Bolt Rush, y la Battle Skill de Perlica suma más. Bolt Rush consume todas las Electric Infliction: cada una sube un nivel la Electrification que aplica, y su talento deja tantas acumulaciones de Sunderization como ese nivel. Al llegar el burst, el Crush de su Ultimate las detona todas.
body.en: Argent Flow's Combo puts Electric Infliction and changes his Battle Skill to Bolt Rush, and Perlica's Battle Skill adds more. Bolt Rush consumes all the Electric Infliction: each one raises the level of the Electrification it applies by one, and his talent leaves as many Sunderization stacks as that level. When the burst comes, his Ultimate's Crush detonates them all.

title.es: El buff de Arclight para los dos carries

body.es: El talento de Arclight da Electric DMG a todo el equipo según su Intellect durante 15 s, tras varias activaciones del efecto adicional de su Battle Skill. El autor insiste en esto porque Argent Flow y Perlica andan cortos de bonus de daño. El tiempo cuenta desde la segunda Battle Skill de Arclight, así que todo lo que sigue tiene que ir rápido.
body.en: Arclight's talent grants the entire team Electric DMG based on her Intellect for 15 s, after several triggers of her Battle Skill's additional effect. The author stresses this because Argent Flow and Perlica are short on damage bonuses. The clock starts at Arclight's second Battle Skill, so everything after it has to be fast.
